conclusion/words#2.note:
FADE IN WITH SCALE
A title comes in small (70%) and faint and grows to its size while it fades in: 0.8 s, ease in-out. Every title and the closing words do it. This frame is the board's step; the video plays the real thing, never a half-faded slide.
conclusion/words#2.name: Fade in with scale · small and faint

conclusion/words#3.name: Fade in with scale · full size

conclusion/words#4.note:
FADE OUT
A title that goes grows a little (10%) while it fades out, over the move to the next scene (0.6 s): the old words are gone before the new ones come. The two frames after are the board's steps. The last title of a video stays on.
conclusion/words#4.name: Fade out · full size

conclusion/words#8.note:
HANDWRITTEN
A pen writes the words along the strokes of the letters, 22 letters a second (the Speed slider, 4 to 60; the blue play button on the frame plays it here). Words first, then the action. Never typed, never half-faded.
conclusion/words#8.name: Handwritten · written by a pen

knowledge/start#3.note:
PANEL WIPE
The software comes in alone, centered, while nothing is said. When words come, the dark panel wipes in from the right edge and the tablet glides to the left to make room (0.6 s); then the words are written.
knowledge/start#3.name: Panel wipe · the software comes in, nothing said

knowledge/words#2.name: Panel wipe · the panel wipes in, the tablet glides left

translation/words#2.note:
CURSOR CLICK
The cursor comes in from the top-left of the words, glides 0.6 s to the exact middle of what it clicks, hovers (the text turns bold, 0.3 s, without moving), presses (a dip, a ring) and THEN the screen changes, dissolving in over the old one: no hard cut. 1.15 s a click.
translation/words#2.name: Cursor click · the cursor arrives

alerts/words#2.note:
HIGHLIGHT
What is only shown (an alert, a timer, a card) gets no hand: a thick yellow rounded outline. It comes in after the art is there (0.25 s later, fading in over 0.25 s) and goes out first. The hand is only for actions.
alerts/words#2.name: Highlight · the outline comes in after the art

links/words#2.name: Highlight · it goes, the next one comes in

emphasis/words#2.note:
ZOOM IN
The same screen at another scale: it scales and moves in one glide, 0.9 s ease in-out, with all it holds. The dark panel over it cuts what runs under the words, so the screen is pushed in, not shrunk back.
emphasis/words#2.name: Zoom in · the whole board

emphasis/words#3.name: Zoom in · pushed in on the closed missions

emphasis/words#4.note:
POP UP
A mission is lifted out of its board: the card rises from its own place on the board, growing and settling a hair over (0.85 s), as the board dims; no outline. Then the board goes and the card glides to the middle (0.85 s). What is isolated is what is talked about.
emphasis/words#4.name: Pop up · the board

instructions/words#2.note:
EXPAND
A card opens into its details: the same screen in two states, so it grows (heights, 0.5 s) and its content scrolls into place, instead of one picture fading into the other.
instructions/words#2.name: Expand · a card

mobile/words#2.note:
SCROLL
A list moves under the cursor: the cursor presses, a swipe up (200 px) and the content scrolls with it. Only where going through a lot is the point (the proofs, the tour, the report).
mobile/words#2.name: Scroll · the list

rate/words#2.note:
DRAG
The cursor presses (0.3 s), carries the rating knob along its track (to 0.75 of the move) and lets go; the knob goes with it, then the cursor goes on to Submit. A screen too big for its side is filmed from further back, whole.
rate/words#2.name: Drag · the mission to rate
